subscribers.contract: Native callback retention, concurrent unawaited broadcast, per-subscriber failure isolation and reentry.

git-streams.contract: GitCache accepts and returns native byte streams; fixture traffic is synthetic pack-like bytes, never a claim of valid Git parsing.

loader.contract: OS dynamically loads worker code and obtains entrypoints; these tests use separate anonymous owned workers.

background.contract: Dispatch is eager, waitUntil extends worker work; caught reporting failure must not disturb foreground work. DO waitUntil has no additional lifetime effect.

codec.contract: Native node:zlib and crypto/byte-stream object processing motivate finite native work under concurrent RPC.

native-transport.contract: Frozen native stream bridge: readable errors normalize to premature disconnect, cancellation carries its reason, writable errors propagate.

stream-runtime.contract: Readable stream readers, cancellation, tee and piping terminal semantics.

writable-runtime.contract: Writable queue, errors, close and abort semantics; write-ack timing is not a cross-runtime oracle.

crypto-runtime.contract: Native digest implementation is exercised through loaded worker entrypoints.

zlib-runtime.contract: Native zlib implementation is exercised through loaded worker entrypoints.
